hero.body: Three specialized agents - Extract, Writer, Assassin - chained into one editorial pipeline. From RSS to publish-ready report in under a minute.

gateway.title: A public overview first, then focused module pages.
gateway.body: Customers do not need to land inside the dashboard. They can start from the product story, open a focused feature page, then move into the real app when they are ready.
gateway.sourceDescription: Show customers how Newsroom connects RSS, websites, and video bloggers before work enters the AI pipeline.
gateway.contentDescription: Explain how intelligence cards, source material, and editorial context stay organized for drafting.
gateway.agentDescription: Introduce configurable agents, model routing, and review roles without exposing the admin dashboard.
gateway.panoramaDescription: A live intelligence wall that scores, categorizes, and refreshes incoming signals for editors.
gateway.workspaceDescription: Turn selected signals into cards, briefs, drafts, inspiration templates, and reusable source material.
gateway.networkDescription: Show customers how Newsroom connects RSS, websites, newsletters, and video creators before AI processing.
gateway.studioDescription: Introduce configurable writing, review, extraction, and illustration agents without exposing admin controls.

sections.discoverTitle: A wall of vetted intelligence, refreshed every minute.
sections.discoverBlurb: Newsroom continuously ingests your feeds, scores each story for relevance, and surfaces only what matters - categorized, deduplicated, and ready to assemble into a brief.

discoverBullets.oneDesc: RSS, newsletters, web pages, video transcripts - unified into one feed.
discoverBullets.twoDesc: Each story scored 0-10 against your editorial rubric. Noise drops below the fold.
discoverBullets.threeDesc: Security, AI, Science, Business - auto-categorized at extraction time.

sections.agentBlurb: Four agent classes - Extractor, Writer, Reviewer, Illustrator - each with its own system prompt, tool access, and workbench. Mix system defaults with custom agents tuned to your house style.
sections.pipelineTitle: Six stages, fully observable, fully overridable.
sections.pipelineBlurb: Every stage exposes its intermediate state. Pause, inspect, edit, or hand off to a human at any point - the pipeline runs as far as you let it.
sections.reviewTitle: A second opinion that never gets tired.
sections.reviewBlurb: The Reviewer agent grades every draft on structure, sourcing, hyperbole, and tone. It flags issues inline, proposes rewrites, and re-scores after your edits - until the report is ready to ship.
sections.kanbanTitle: Long-running agent jobs, tracked like engineering tickets.
sections.kanbanBlurb: Every Writer or Reviewer task gets a TSK ID, a column, and a state. Watch your editorial backlog drain in real time, retry failed runs, or hand a stuck task to a human.
sections.ctaBody: Newsroom is currently invite-only. We are onboarding intelligence teams, editorial desks, and analyst groups one by one.
sections.footerTagline: The editorial pipeline for modern intelligence teams. Built for analysts who write for a living.
sections.workspaceTitle: A content desk between raw intelligence and finished drafts.
sections.workspaceBlurb: Content Workspace is where editors turn useful signals into structured cards, inspiration blocks, writing tasks, and reusable source context.
sections.workspaceCardOneDesc: Save the strongest discoveries from the panorama into a reusable working set.
sections.workspaceCardTwoDesc: Collect angles, outlines, references, and source snippets before drafting starts.
sections.workspaceCardThreeDesc: Hand curated materials to Writer and Reviewer agents with context intact.

sourceManagement.headlineBefore: Bring every beat into one governed
sourceManagement.body: Connect RSS feeds, websites, newsletters, and video creators before they enter the AI newsroom. Customers see the system story here; editors operate the real module after login.
sourceManagement.signalBody: Fresh, deduplicated, and topic-scored material is ready for the editorial pipeline.
sourceManagement.governanceTitle: Not just more feeds. Better controlled intake.
sourceManagement.governanceBody: The public page explains the value without exposing admin controls. The authenticated `/sources` module keeps the operational surface protected.
sourceManagement.customerPathTitle: Overview first, module page second, app last.
sourceManagement.customerPathBody: This keeps demos clean: a customer can understand Source Management before touching protected newsroom operations.
sourceManagement.boundary: Public page / protected app boundary intact
